script.title: SHOULDERS, NOT SHORTER
script.story_hook: June visits the salon for her dream cut.
script.intro_zh: 朱恩來到髮廊，想剪一個剛剛好的頭髮。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back! Today we're at the hair salon.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來！今天我們來到髮廊。
script.outro: New hair, new mood, booked again. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 剪了新髮型，心情也跟著煥然一新。下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the salon phrases together, shall we?
script.practice_intro_zh: 一起跟讀髮廊會話，從頭練到尾。
script.char_a_description: a stylish woman in her late thirties, dark brown hair past her shoulders, gold hoop earrings, a lilac blouse with rolled sleeves, black trousers, low heels, average build, holding a quilted handbag.
script.char_b_description: a tidy man in his forties, neat dark hair with gray temples, a charcoal vest over a white shirt, slim black pants, polished shoes, medium build, wearing small reading glasses.
script.youtube_title: 【建議收藏】💇‍♀️用英文說出理想髮型，60句美式聽力｜瀏海、分層、價格全聽懂｜越聽越會說🌱✂️Getting the Right Haircut
script.youtube_title_en: "Same Time, Same Chair" - Getting the Right Haircut at a Salon
script.youtube_description:
想剪一個剛剛好的頭髮，英文該怎麼說？
髮廊諮詢台前的一問一答：保留長度、空氣瀏海、兩側分層，還有燙髮選項與刷卡小風波，60 句連貫美語一次聽個過癮。
你會聽到：
🎧 開場預約："Hi! I called earlier about a cut."
🎧 描述髮型："Should I cut bangs or leave them out?"
🎧 詢問價格："That's a big difference. How much?"
🎧 預約下次："Same time, same chair. Booked!"
後半段為逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽懂、再跟著說。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
每天一段生活對話，越聽越順。
喜歡請訂閱、按讚並開啟小鈴鐺，下一集見！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en: Dream haircut? Say it clearly in English! This salon dialogue follows June through consultation, photo book, layers, bangs, a perm decision, and even a card reader hiccup. You get 60 lines of natural American English about real small problems and easy fixes. The second half is a sentence-by-sentence listen-and-repeat workout. Perfect for A2 learners preparing for a haircut abroad. No memorizing, just listen often and absorb. Subscribe for a new daily-life dialogue every week. #EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧髮廊剪髮英文｜講長度・選瀏海・問價格｜聽完就能說｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背多聽就會用｜🎧60句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
到國外剪頭髮，怎麼跟設計師說「不要剪太短」？
瀏海、分層、燙髮、價格，每一項都要開口，你準備好了嗎？
這一集帶大家走進美式髮廊，看朱恩從描述理想髮型、翻相簿挑照片，到半頭燙的取捨、讀卡機罷工的小風波。
你會聽到：
🎧 開場預約："Hi! I called earlier about a cut." 上門報備第一步。
🎧 描述需求："Should I cut bangs or leave them out?" 剪不剪瀏海這樣問。
🎧 價格取捨："Half-wave for thirty? That works!" 預算有限也能開心成交。
🎧 預約下次："Same time, same chair. Booked!" 最道地的收尾句。
後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 60 個句子先聽一遍、再跟著說一遍，從耳朵練到嘴巴。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。聽熟了，換你坐進椅子也不慌。
願你每一次剪髮，都剛好是自己想要的樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! I called earlier about a cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ kɔːld ˈɜɹli ɚ əˈbaʊt ə kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我先前打過電話要剪頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome in! What are we doing today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm ɪn wʌt ɑɹ wi ˈduɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨！今天想怎麼剪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A trim, and maybe some light layers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tɹɪm ænd ˈmeɪbi sʌm laɪt ˈleɪɚz/
dialogue.zh: 修剪一下，再來點輕盈的分層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got a reference photo? We can start there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ə ˈɛfəɹəns ˈfoʊtoʊ wi kæn stɑɹt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 有參考照片嗎？我們可以從那開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do, but my phone is dead right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du bʌt maɪ foʊn ɪz dɛd raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有帶，但我手機現在沒電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, just describe it for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜɹiz dʒʌst dɪˈskɹaɪb ɪt fɔɹ mi/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，描述給我就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, shoulder length, but don't go too short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈʃoʊldɚ ˈlɛŋθ bʌt doʊnt ɡoʊ tu ʃɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，到肩膀就好，不要剪太短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, trim the ends and add soft layers.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ tɹɪm ði ɛndz ænd æd sɔːft ˈleɪɚz/
dialogue.zh: 所以是修髮尾，再加柔和分層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Layers on the sides, not too short.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈleɪɚz ɑn ðə saɪdz nɑt tu ʃɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 對！兩側打層，不要太短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I cut bangs or leave them out?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kʌt bæŋɡɚz ɔɹ liv ðɛm aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 瀏海要剪嗎？還是先留著？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, tiny see-through ones, if that's safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈtaɪni si θɹu wʌnz ɪf ðæts seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，空氣瀏海可以嗎？如果不傷頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll snip a little and test the look.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl snɪp ə ˈlɪtəl ænd tɛst ðə lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 我們先小小剪一下，看看感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have photo books I can browse?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈfoʊtoʊ bʊks aɪ kæn bɹaʊz/
dialogue.zh: 你們有相簿可以讓我翻嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! The book is right on that shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə bʊk ɪz raɪt ɑn ðæt ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 有！相簿就在那邊的架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it! This style, number twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ðɪs staɪl ˈnʌmbɚ ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 找到了！這個造型，第二十號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The waves with the soft side bangs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə weɪvz wɪð ðə sɔːft saɪd bæŋɡz/
dialogue.zh: 波浪捲配側分瀏海那個？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the one. Can I point at it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði wʌn kæn aɪ pɔɪnt æt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就是它。我可以用手指給你看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, point away, I'll get it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs pɔɪnt əˈweɪ aɪl ɡɛt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，指給我看，我懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here: the ends and this bang shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ði ɛndz ænd ðɪs bæŋ ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 這裡：髮尾，還有瀏海的弧度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I'll blend the sides like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑ ɪt aɪl blɛnd ðə saɪdz laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 了解，兩側我會銜接著剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how long will this take?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ lɔːŋ wɪl ðɪs teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那要剪多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty-five, plus the blow-dry after.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti faɪv plʌs ðə bloʊ draɪ ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 四十五分鐘，加上之後的吹整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That fits. What do you charge here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt fɪts wʌt du ju tʃɑɹdʒ hiɹ/
dialogue.zh: 時間剛好。這裡收費多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seventy for a cut like that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvənti fɔɹ ə kʌt laɪk ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 像那樣修剪是七十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My last cut cost just fifty elsewhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ læst kʌt kɔst dʒʌst ˈfɪfti ˈɛlsˈwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我上次在外面剪才五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We include a deep treatment too.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɪnˈklud ə dip ˈtɹitmənt tu/
dialogue.zh: 我們還附贈深層護髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You read my mind. Do you wash hair?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɹid maɪ maɪnd du ju wɑʃ hɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你懂我！這裡可以洗頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, shampoo and blow-dry are included.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃæmˈpu ænd bloʊ draɪ ɑɹ ɪnˈkludɪd/
dialogue.zh: 可以，洗髮和吹整都包含在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About a perm, what's a barrel curl?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ə pɜɹm wʌts ə ˈbæɹəl kɜɹl/
dialogue.zh: 說起燙髮，桶狀捲是什麼樣子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bouncy curl that frames your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbaʊnsi kɜɹl ðæt fɹeɪmz jɔɹ feɪs/
dialogue.zh: 有彈性的捲度，正好修飾臉型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, what about a soft wave instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm wʌt əˈbaʊt ə sɔːft weɪv ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那換成柔和的波浪捲呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave lasts two months, curl lasts four.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪv læsts tu mʌnθs kɜɹl læsts fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 波浪捲撐兩個月，桶捲撐四個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a big difference. How much?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə bɪɡ ˈdɪfɹəns haʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 差很多耶。要加多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wave adds sixty to your total.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə weɪv ædz ˈsɪksti tə jɔɹ ˈtoʊtəl/
dialogue.zh: 波浪捲要在總價外加六十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty? Um... that's more than I planned.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti ʌm ðæts mɔɹ ðæn aɪ plænd/
dialogue.zh: 六十？嗯……比我預算高了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can do just the ends, half price.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn du dʒʌst ði ɛndz hæf pɹaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 也可以只燙髮尾，價錢一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half-wave for thirty? That works!
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf weɪv fɔɹ ˈθɜɹti ðæt wɜks/
dialogue.zh: 三十塊做半頭波浪？可以！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. And it grows out very softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ænd ɪt ɡɹoʊz aʊt ˈvɛɹi ˈsɔːftli/
dialogue.zh: 對，而且長出來也很自然。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold! Can I pay by card now?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld kæn aɪ peɪ baɪ kɑɹd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 成交！我現在可以刷卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but my reader is slow today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ bʌt maɪ ˈɹidɚ ɪz sloʊ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過讀卡機今天很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow? What do you mean by that?
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ wʌt du ju min baɪ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 很慢？那是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It refuses cards sometimes. Cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɹɪˈfjuz kɑɹdz ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 它有的時候會拒絕刷卡。現金也行？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um... let me check my wallet, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm lɛt mi tʃɛk maɪ ˈwɑlɪt wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯……我看一下錢包，稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, no rush at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔɹ taɪm noʊ ɹʌʃ æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，不用趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only have forty in cash, oops.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv ˈfɔɹti ɪn kæʃ ʊps/
dialogue.zh: 我現金只有四十，慘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fine! Pay the rest tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn peɪ ðə ɹɛst təˈmɑɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！剩下的明天再來補。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? You're the sweetest, thank you!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli jʊɹ ðə ˈswitəst θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？你人太好了，多謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens. I'll note it on your file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz aɪl noʊt ɪt ɑn jɔɹ faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 常有的事，我幫你在檔案上註記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. And save me next Tuesday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ænd seɪv mi nɛkst ˈtuzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。下週二也幫我留個時段？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same time, same chair. Booked!
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm taɪm seɪm tʃɛɹ bʊkt/
dialogue.zh: 同一個時間、同一張椅子，訂好囉！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How should I style it at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ʃʊd aɪ staɪl æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 回家之後我該怎麼整理造型？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scratch the ends and let air do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɹætʃ ði ɛndz ænd lɛt ɛɹ du ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 抓鬆髮尾，讓它自然乾就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's it? You make it sound easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt ju meɪk ɪt saʊnd ˈizɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就這樣？你說起來好簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is! And don't wash hair tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ænd doʊnt wɑʃ hɛɹ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就是這麼簡單！今晚先別洗頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No washing, got it. Any care tips?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɑʃɪŋ ɡɑ ɪt ˈɛni kɛɹ tips/
dialogue.zh: 今晚不洗頭，記下了。有保養建議嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oil the ends twice a week, that's all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɪl ði ɛndz twaɪs ə wik ðæts ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 一週幫髮尾上兩次護髮油，就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more: can I add a tip today?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ kæn aɪ æd ə tɪp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事：今天可以先加小費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tips are optional, but thank you!
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪps ɑɹ ˈɑpʃənəl bʌt θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 小費不拘，但還是先謝謝你！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, for the help and the patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ fɔɹ ðə hɛlp ænd ðə ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 這一張給你，謝謝你的幫忙和耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're sweet. See you Tuesday, bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ swit si ju ˈtuzˌdeɪ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你太體貼了，週二再見！
